blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— Two persons, one of them a young boy, were found dead in a creek beside the National Highway near Barangay Lang-Ayan in Currimao, Ilocos Norte, in an incident believed to have involved a motorcycle crash. According to an initial police investigation, a passerby discovered a slipper along the roadside on Sunday, Nov.1, that led him to the remains of a 23-year-old construction worker and a boy of undetermined age lying beside a motorcycle.
